title: Maler- og beleggstjenester i Troms fylkeskommune
description: Bakgrunn Troms fylkeskommune har ansvar for forvaltning, drift og vedlikehold av en bygningsmasse som blant annet omfatter videregående skoler, tannklinikker og tjenesteboliger i hele Troms. For å ivareta løpende vedlikeholdsbehov og mindre rehabiliterings- og ombyggingsoppdrag er det behov for forutsigbar tilgang til maler- og beleggstjenester. Oppdragsgiver har per i dag ingen avtale på området. Anskaffelsen gjennomføres derfor for å etablere en rammeavtale og sikre kostnadseffektive og rasjonelle innkjøp i tråd med gjeldende regelverk. Et sentralt formål er å forenkle og standardisere bestillingsprosessen på tvers av lokasjoner og bestillere, samt bidra til mer forutsigbar leveranse og kvalitet. Behovet varierer geografisk og mellom lokasjoner. Oppdragene vil i hovedsak omfatte arbeid i eksisterende bygg, ofte mens ordinær drift pågår. Leverandører må derfor kunne planlegge og gjennomføre arbeidene på en måte som tar hensyn til brukere og virksomhet, herunder tilpasse utførelsen til perioder hvor vedlikeholdsarbeidet med fordel kan gjennomføres i skolens ferie- og friperioder. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder etablering av en rammeavtale for maler- og beleggstjenester til Troms fylkeskommunes bygg og eiendommer i Troms. Rammeavtalen skal dekke løpende behov for vedlikehold, utbedringer og mindre ombyggings-/rehabiliteringsoppdrag, samt håndtering av skader ved behov. Leveransen vil omfatte innvendig og utvendig malerarbeid, overflatebehandling samt legging, utskifting og reparasjon av gulvbelegg. Arbeid knyttet til våtrom kan inngå der dette er relevant for oppdragsgivers bygningsmasse. Tjenestene vil primært omfatte eksisterende bygg; ved nybygg kan arbeidene inngå i separate entrepriseformer og dermed falle utenfor rammeavtalen. Oppdragsgiver har delt rammeavtalen inn i fire delkontrakter basert på geografiske avstand (Tromsø, Nord-Troms, Midt-Troms og Sør-Troms), med inntil 1–2 leverandører per delkontrakt. Avrop under rammeavtalen er planlagt gjennomført som direkte bestilling fra oppdragsgiver.

title: Statlig fellesavtale for kjøp av PC-utstyr
description: Anskaffelsens formål er å etablere en fellesavtale som sikrer statlige virksomheter enkel og effektiv tilgang til klientutstyr, herunder PC-klienter, PC-skjermer og Mac med tilhørende tilleggsutstyr og tilleggstjenester, som understøtter en sikker og produktiv arbeidsflate for statlig ansatte. Basert på forbruksdata fra eksisterende avtaler og antall ansatte i deltakende virksomheter, estimerer avtaleeier at det årlig vil bli kjøpt om lag 28 000 PC-klienter, 19 000 PC-skjermer og 1 900 Mac på avtalen. Medregnet forventet kjøp av tilleggsutstyr og tilleggstjenester anslås avtalens årlige omsetning til om lag 600 MNOK. Avtaleeier gjør oppmerksom på at dette er et estimat som ikke er forpliktende for avtaleeier eller de deltakende oppdragsgiverne mht. kjøpsforpliktelser. Maksimal kontraktsverdi for hele avtaleperioden, inklusive eventuelle opsjonsperioder, er satt til 4 000 MNOK. Deltakende virksomheter/oppdragsgivere som deltar på denne fellesavtalen fremgår av bilag 11: Oppdragsgivere omfattet av avtalen.

title: Langsgående vegoppmerking Innlandet 2027-2030
description: Arbeidenes art og omfang Arbeidene omfatter langsgående vegoppmerking, samt fresing for vegoppmerking. Innlandet fylkeskommune har i dag én formerker, men kan trenge periodevis bistand til formerking. Kontraktsområdet er hele Innlandet fylke. Ved motstrid mellom informasjon i konkurransegjennomføringsverktøyet og vedlagte dokumenter (vedlegg/bilag), gjelder informasjon i dokumentene (vedlegg/bilag) foran informasjon i konkurransegjennomføringsverktøyet. Kontraktsperioden er 2027-2030. Byggherre og entreprenør har gjensidig opsjon på å forlenge kontrakten med 1+1 år. Med gjensidig opsjon menes at begge partene må samtykke til opsjon/forlengelse av eksisterende avtale på eksisterende vilkår. Det vil ikke være anledning til å reforhandle avtalen i forbindelse med opsjonsutøvelsen. En eventuell forlengelse av avtalen skal være avtalt innen 6 måneder før utløpet av den ordinære driftsperioden. Mengder som er gitt i kapittel D (prosessene) og kapittel E (mengdeskjema) gjelder per år, og er regulerbare iht. NS 8406 pkt. 19.1, fjerde ledd. title: Konkurranse - 241012 - C06864 - Byggherreombud NAWSARH Bodø (Opsjon Tromsø)
description: Forsvarsbygg inviterer leverandøren til å inngi tilbud på følgende oppdrag: BHO for NAWSARH i Bodø med opsjon på BHO på NAWSARH i Tromsø. Det skal leveres et BHO som eventuelt dekker begge lokasjonene hvis opsjonen utløses. Det skal kun leveres en person i tilbudet.Prosjektet omfatter etablering av nytt hangaranlegg for redningstjenesten i Bodø, basert på konseptet for standardbase med tre helikopterdokker (én beredskapsdokk og to vedlikeholdsdokker), samt tilhørende funksjoner for operativ drift, administrasjon, verksted, lager og internat.Tomt for hangaranlegget er nå lokalisert på «Stanghaugen» med god tilkomst til fly operative arealer i NLBO. Plasseringen er tilpasset utformingen av ny lufthavn og overordnet infrastruktur. Landside adkomst til hangaranlegget etableres fra øst. På flyside etableres direkte adkomst til ny TWY Y og rullebane, slik at operative krav til responstid og effektiv trafikkavvikling ivaretas.Anlegget blir etablert i Avinor/ NLBO sitt anleggsområde med eget byggegjerde. I byggeperioden skal kontakten mellom totalentreprenør og NLBO utbyggingsprosjekt styres gjennom fastsatte koordineringsmøter.

title: Inspisientsystem til DNS sitt moderniseringsprosjekt
description: Oppdragsgivers formål med denne anskaffelsen er å inngå kontrakt om levering av inspisient-anlegg, som skal fungere som overordnet styrings- og automatiseringssystem for inspisientfunksjonene. Anskaffelsen omfatter også tilhørende løsninger for regikommunikasjon, medhør, medsyn, CUE-lys, infrastruktur og tekstskjermer. Deler av leveransene er skilt ut som opsjoner, av blant annet av budsjettmessige hensyn. Hvilke opsjoner som blir løst ut avklares primært i løpet av detaljprosjekteringsfasen. Siste frist for å løse ut opsjoner for utstyr er tidspunkt for overlevering av anlegg. Se bilag 3 Prisskjema for oversikt over hva som er opsjoner. Systemet skal gi inspisient og teknisk personell et felles verktøy for styring, overvåking og koordinering av produksjonsrelaterte funksjoner. Systemet er ment som et operasjonelt grensesnitt mellom mennesker og tekniske systemer, og skal ikke erstatte dedikerte lyd-, lys-, video- eller scenetekniske kontrollsystemer

title: Rammeavtale for anskaffelsesfaglig bistand

Avtalen skal primært dekke operativ bistand til planlegging, gjennomføring og kvalitetssikring av offentlige anskaffelser, men kan også omfatte rådgivning, analyse- og utredningsarbeid, kontraktsoppfølging, prosessforbedring og kompetansehevende tiltak. Oppdragene kan variere fra kortvarige rådgivningsoppdrag til lengre ressursinnleie. Norske tog har som hensikt inngå rammeavtale med én leverandør. title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Hafen Trier: Planungs- und Ingenieurleistungen zur Errichtung einer Multi-Purpose-Halle in Anlehnung an die Leistungsphasen 1-9 der HOAI
description: Die Bauherrin beabsichtigt, auf ihrem Grundstück an der Montanstraße in Trier den Bau einer Multi - Purpose-Halle für logistische Nutzungen zu errichten. Dazu ist entsprechend dieser Bekanntmachung ein Verhandlungsverfahren mit einem vorgeschalteten öffentlichen Teilnahmewettbewerb vorgesehen. In der Phase 1 werden Teilnahmeanträge ausgereicht, über deren Auswertung die Teilnehmer an der Angebotsphase ermittelt werden. Dem folgend werden die Verdingungsunterlagen an einen reduzierten Kreis von Bietern versandt. Vorgesehen ist, im Zusammenwirken mit dem zukünftigen Nutzer, im Planungsobjekt ein betriebliches Konzept für Papierlogistik mit Erweiterungsmöglichkeiten auf andere Sorten und Materialien zu realisieren. Die Realisierung dieses Vorhabens erfordert nicht zuletzt aufgrund der engen Budget- und Terminvorgaben eine intensive Kommunikation, Koordination und Zusammenarbeit zwischen und unter allen Projektbeteiligten. Die zum Projekterfolg notwenigen inhaltlichen Anforderungen an andere Mitwirkende sind rechtzeitig zu entwickeln und mit dem Auftraggeber umzusetzen. Die Teilnahmeanträge können auf der Veröffentlichungsplattform abgerufen werden. Eine Kommunikation mit der Auftraggeberin findet ebenfalls dokumentiert über die Plattform statt. Teilnahmeanträge sind zum bekanntgemachten Termin über die Plattform einzureichen. Erforderliche Unterschriften im Teilnahmeantrag sind in diesem gekennzeichnet und durch den Bewerber digital zu unterschreiben. Nicht getätigte Unterschriften führen zum Ausschluss vom Wettbewerb.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Sanierung der zentralen Bettenaufbereitung im Westpfalz-Klinikum Kaiserslautern
description: Die seit 1959 in Haus 7 betriebene Bettenzentrale wurde fortlaufend aus Eigenmitteln instand gehalten. Partielle regelmäßig auftretende Wasserschäden durch das befahrbare Flachdach haben den Gebäudebetrieb beeinträchtigt und mussten temporär behoben werden. Mit der Kernsanierung des Bettenhauses 8 und der damit verbundenen Errichtung einer überdachten Liegendkrankenzufahrt wurde die befahrbare STB-Decke der Bettenzentrale abgeschält und in der gesamten Fläche nun grundlegend saniert. Da die Bettenaufbereitung weiterhin zentral im Haupthaus erfolgt, besteht nun die Möglichkeit, die dort richtig positionierte Bettenzentrale nachhaltig zu sanieren. Neben der bautechnischen Mängelbeseitigung steht die Optimierung der internen Betriebsabläufe im Fokus. Durch die Neugestaltung des Grundrisses sollen logistische Prozesse effizienter gestaltet werden. Insbesondere kreuzungsfreie Wege, speziell die strikte Trennung von reinen und unreinen Arbeitsbereichen, sollen konsequent umgesetzt werden, um die höchsten Hygienestandards dauerhaft zu garantieren. Die Terminplanung des Projektes ist zwingend so auszurichten, dass eine vollständige und prüffähige Aufstellung der HU-Bau im zweiten Quartal 2027 gewährleistet ist.

title: Tauralaukio rajono teritorijos, pagal Klaipėdos miesto bendrojo plano sprendinius patenkančios į 9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 9.4, 9.8 ir 9.9 nagrinėjamus rajonus, urbanistinės idėjos atviras projekto konkursas.
description: ATVIRAS PROJEKTO KONKURSAS. Tauralaukio rajono teritorijos, pagal Klaipėdos miesto bendrojo plano sprendinius patenkančios į 9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 9.4, 9.8 ir 9.9 nagrinėjamus rajonus, urbanistinės idėjos atviras projekto konkursas. Projekto konkurso tikslas - išrinkti geriausiai urbanistinius, architektūros ir funkcinius aspektus bei kitus reikalavimus, išvardintus konkurso sąlygose, atitinkančią Tauralaukio rajono teritorijos, pagal Klaipėdos miesto bendrojo plano sprendinius patenkančios į 9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 9.4, 9.8 ir 9.9 nagrinėjamus rajonus, urbanistinės idėjos projektą, kurio pagrindu ateityje bus rengiami teritorijų planavimo dokumentai ir vystoma ši Tauralaukio rajono teritorija. Biudžetas: šio projekto konkurso pirkimo objekto įgyvendinimui (t.y. urbanistinės koncepcijos parengimui) suplanuota suma - 50 000 Eur su PVM (41 322,31 Eur be PVM). Vadovaujantis VPĮ 55 str. 3 d. Perkančioji organizacija konkurso dokumentuose iš anksto nustato fiksuotą kainą projekto konkurso pirkimo objekto įgyvendinimui (t.y. urbanistinės koncepcijos parengimui) - 50 000 Eur su PVM (arba 41 322,31 Eur be PVM, jei tiekėjas yra ne PVM mokėtojas ar paslaugos neapmokestinamos PVM, ar dėl kitų priežasčių, dėl kurių Perkančiosios organizacijos galutinė tiekėjui mokėtina suma bus be PVM). Projekto konkurso pirmąsias 3 vietas užėmusius dalyvius numatyta apdovanoti piniginiais prizais (premijomis), skiriant 40 000 Eur, prizinį fondą išskirstant tokia seka: I vieta – 16 000 Eur; II vieta – 14 000 Eur; III vieta – 10 000 Eur. Perkančioji organizacija laimėjusiu nustato tik 1 (vieną) dalyvį, surinkusį daugiausiai balų ir esantį pirmoje vietoje, neatitikusį pašalinimo pagrindų ir atitikusį nustatytus kvalifikacijos reikalavimus. Su projekto konkurso laimėtoju numatoma sudaryti paslaugų pirkimo–pardavimo sutartį dėl urbanistinės koncepcijos parengimo.

title: Sanierung Mehrfamilienhaus - Kopernikusring 1-9, 36-44 16227 Eberswalde, Deutschland, Fassadenarbeiten
description: Das Bauvorhaben umfasst die Sanierung und Modernisierung der bestehenden Mehrfamilienhäuser. Die Gebäude stammen aus dem Jahr 1973 und umfassen insgesamt ca. 180 Wohneinheiten mit einer Gesamtwohnfläche von ca. 10.967 m². Der Wohnungsbestand ist überwiegend vermietet; eine Teilsanierung erfolgte im Jahr 1994. Weitere Leerwohnungsinstandsetzungen finden seit dem Jahr 2025 statt und sind bei der Abstimmung der Schnittstellen zu berücksichtigen. Die zu vergebenden Leistungen betreffen die Instandsetzung und malermäßige Überarbeitung der bestehenden Fassaden einschließlich der zugehörigen Untergrundvorbereitungs-, Schutz-, Anschluss- und Nebenarbeiten. Die vorhandenen Außenwände bestehen gemäß Modernisierungskonzept aus ca. 29 cm Leichtbeton und einem bestehenden Wärmedämmverbundsystem mit ca. 8 cm EPS-Dämmung einschließlich Armierungsschicht und Oberputz. Das vorhandene Wärmedämmverbundsystem soll grundsätzlich erhalten und in schadhaften Bereichen örtlich instand gesetzt bzw. teilweise erneuert werden. Eine vollflächige Erneuerung oder Aufdopplung der Fassadendämmung ist im Modernisierungskonzept nicht vorgesehen. Die Arbeiten erfolgen überwiegend im bewohnten Bestand. Der Schutz der Bewohner, die Nutzbarkeit der erforderlichen Gebäudezugänge sowie der Schutz vorhandener und bereits erneuerter Bauteile sind zu berücksichtigen. Fördervorbehalt BEG EM, aufschiebende Bedingung Die ausgeschriebenen Leistungen sind Gegenstand einer beantragten Förderung nach BEG EM. Der Vertrag wird mit Zuschlag geschlossen; die Lieferungs- und Leistungspflichten stehen unter der aufschiebenden Bedingung der Förderzusage. Sie werden erst und nur insoweit wirksam, wie die beantragte Förderung durch die zuständige Förderstelle bewilligt wird. Der Auftraggeber informiert den Auftragnehmer über den Eintritt der Bedingung unverzüglich in Textform. description: W6699-270004/B - Tire Servicing Equipment Reissue of Solicitation of Offers. Bidders must clearly demonstrate compliance with each mandatory technical criterion. Bid documents submitted and/or received after the closing time and date will not be accepted. The Crown retains the rights to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada.

description: Předmětem této veřejné zakázky je provedení činností dle projektové dokumentace s názvem „Bývalý areál KOVOŠROT GROUP CZ, Praha - Dolní Měcholupy, Projektová dokumentace sanace staré ekologické zátěže, ETAPA 2: ODSTRANĚNÍ ODPADŮ“, zpracované v lednu 2026 společností ENACON s.r.o., která je přílohou č. 3 ZD. Tato skutečná množství jsou prezentována ve formě aktualizace v příloze 3.1 Dodatek projektu sanace - upřesnění PD – skutečné množství 2. etapy. Cílem prací je odstranění odpadů v rozsahu projektové dokumentace; uskutečnění opatření k nápravě uložených v Rozhodnutí ČIŽP OI Praha.

title: Perho Liiketalousopisto Oy:n tukkuhankinnat
description: Perho Liiketalousopisto Oy:n tukkuhankinnat Hankinnan kohteena on elintarvikkeiden, alkoholittomien ja alkoholijuomien ja non-food -tuotteiden hankinta ja niiden toimitukset Perho Liiketalousopisto Oy:n ravintoloihin ja opetuskeittiöihin Helsingissä (Ravintola Perho ja ravintola Herkku Töölössä ja ravintola Perhon Helmi Malmilla). Hankinnan tavoitteena on löytää yksi (1) päätukkutoimittaja, jonka toimitus- ja tilausajat vastaavat Perho Liiketalousopisto Oy:n ravintoloiden tarpeita. Tavaratoimitusten tulee tapahtua vastuullisesti, tehokkaasti, toimitusvarmasti ja edullisesti. Perho voi tehdä muita hankintoja erillisiltä toimittajilta hankintalainsäädännön ja sopimusten mukaisesti. Hankinta ei anna yksinoikeutta kaikkiin Perhon ostoihin. Ravintoloissa on pienet varastointimahdollisuudet, joten niistä tehdään tilauksia päivittäin. Vähäisestä varastotilasta johtuen tukusta täytyy pystyä tilaamaan myös purettuja myyntieriä. Tarkemmat kuvaukset hankinnan sisällöstä löytyy tarjouspyynnön kohdasta 'Hankinnan kohteen kriteerit'.,

title: Arkkitehtuurikutsukilpailu: Hämeen ammattikorkeakoulun keskustakampus
description: Arkkitehtuurikutsukilpailu: Hämeen ammattikorkeakoulun keskustakampus Hämeen ammattikorkeakoulu (HAMK) järjestää Hämeenlinnan Hämeensaaren uuden keskustakampuksen suunnittelusta arkkitehtuurikutsukilpailun yhteistyössä Hämeenlinnan kaupungin ja Suomen Arkkitehtiliitto SAFA:n kanssa. Kilpailutehtävänä on suunnitella arkkitehtonisesti korkeatasoinen ja toiminnallinen uusi keskustakampuskokonaisuus, joka palvelee HAMKia, sekä hämeenlinnalaisia. Uudisrakentamisen määrä on hankkeen ensimmäisen vaiheen kokonaan toteuduttua arviolta 12 000 hym². Kilpailussa tutkitaan kampusrakennuksen ja sen piharatkaisun liittymistä kaupunkirakenteeseen, Vanajaveden rantaan, julkisiin ulkotiloihin, liikenneverkkoon ja ympäröivään keskustaan. Hankkeessa haetaan pontta alueen kehittämisen käynnistymiselle huomioiden kytkeytyminen Hämeenlinnan keskustaan. Suunnittelukilpailun voittajan kanssa voidaan tehdä palveluhankintasopimus hankkeen asemakaavan kehittämisestä ja myöhemmästä jatko- ja toteutussuunnittelusta. Hankkeen lopullisen toteutumisen edellytyksenä on lainvoimainen asemakaava ja rahoituksen varmistuminen. Kilpailu on kaksivaiheinen niin, että ensimmäisessä vaiheessa pyydetään kaikilta halukkailta osallistujilta osallistumishakemukset. Osallistumishakemukset arvioidaan osallistumispyynnöllä esitettyjen vertailukriteereiden mukaisesti ja viisi (5) parasta kelpoisuusvaatimukset täyttävää hakijaa valitaan toiseen vaiheeseen varsinaiseen suunnittelukilpailuun. Viidelle valitulle kilpailijalle maksetaan kullekin 15 000 euroa (+alv) kilpailuohjelman mukaisesta määräajassa palautetusta kilpailutyöstä. Palkkiot maksetaan Suomen Arkkitehtiliiton kautta ja SAFA perii 7 % palkinnoista kilpailusääntöjensä mukaisesti. Kilpailun tarkemmat tiedot ja aikataulu on esitetty osallistumispyynnön liitteenä olevassa kilpailuohjelman luonnoksessa.,

title: U006--VR&E Self-Employment Services RFI
description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) SUBJECT Exploring the Feasibility of VA Partnering with Industry to Ready Disabled Veterans for Self-Employment (i.e., entrepreneurship; small business ownership) 1.0 INTRODUCTION The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Benefits Administration (VBA), is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) for Veteran Readiness & Employment (VR&E) Self-Employment Services. The information provided in response to this request may be used by VBA in developing its acquisition strategy and refining the Performance Work Statement (PWS). THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this RFI or otherwise pay for the information requested. Responses will be treated as information only and not as a proposal. There is no obligation for the Government to acquire any products or services described in this RFI. In accordance with the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) Subpart 15.101(c)(2), responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. 2.0 BACKGROUND VBA s VR&E Service, pursuant to Title 38 United States Code Chapter 31 (see Section 3100), provides to eligible Veterans with compensable service-connected disabilities all services and assistance necessary to enable them to achieve maximum independence in daily living and, to the maximum extent feasible, to become employable and to obtain and maintain suitable employment. After achieving the degree of rehabilitation needed to become suitably employed, VR&E is expected to assist Veterans in the pursuit of suitable employment. One such avenue through which VR&E assists is utilizing VR&E s Self-Employment Track, which is intended to assist eligible Veterans in achieving their vocational goals in entrepreneurship and business ownership. Services include the following: Developing and strengthening a business plan Training in small-business operations, marketing, finances, etc. Assessing the feasibility of implementing such a business plan Obtaining (through loans or grants) the resources necessary to implement a business plan and incorporate the business such as securing loans Purchasing of equipment, acquiring initial stocks and supplies, etc. Specialized expertise and/or support to assist Veterans interested in self-employment includes, but is not limited to, knowledge of local/state/federal laws associated with starting a business;� market research/analysis both from the perspective of assessing viability of the prospective business in the job market and through the lens of purchasing subject matter expertise and purchasing equipment/supplies; and� potential screening or other assessment tools for specialized job markets (i.e. ability to run background checks and/or credit checks to assess criminal history, driving records, substance use/abuse, financial/credit/tax history, education, etc.). Further, VA recognizes that achieving successful self-employment outcomes often requires specialized expertise beyond traditional vocational rehabilitation services. Veterans pursuing entrepreneurship may need support with business planning, feasibility analysis, market research, financial literacy, regulatory compliance, business startup requirements, mentorship, and access to entrepreneurial networks and resources. Self-employment cases frequently involve complex business considerations that require specialized knowledge, individualized assessments, and coordination with public and private sector resources. Veterans may require assistance evaluating business viability, developing comprehensive business plans, understanding applicable licensing and regulatory requirements, conducting market and financial analyses, identifying startup resource needs, and building the skills necessary to successfully operate a small business. These needs often require tailored, ongoing guidance throughout the planning and launch process. VA is seeking information on how experienced industry partners can supplement existing VR&E services by providing subject matter expertise, structured entrepreneurial training, business feasibility assessments, market research capabilities, business financial planning and analysis (i.e., financial projections, startup cost estimates, cash flow planning, and capital requirements), and access to established business support networks. Such services may help Veterans make informed business decisions, evaluate and strengthen the viability of proposed business ventures, develop stronger business plans, and access the expertise and resources needed to successfully launch and sustain a small business. Accordingly, VA requests information from organizations with demonstrated experience providing entrepreneur and small business support services, including business advisory services, training, business feasibility and market assessments, entrepreneurial training, startup incubation, financial planning, and other related support services. The goal is to identify potential partnership approaches that can enhance VA's ability to assist Veterans with service-connected disabilities in evaluating business concepts, developing viable business plans, preparing for business ownership, and successfully launching and sustaining small businesses 3.0 INFORMATION SOUGHT The Government is seeking the following information from vendors responding to this RFI: Organization and Contact Information, specifically: Name of Organization Addresses for Primary Locations of Operation Points of Contact (available for follow-up discussions) Phone Numbers and Email Addresses for Points of Contact Business Size and Socioeconomic Status Answers to List of Questions (See Section 5.0 of this RFI) Past Performance (if applicable) describing how your organization: has supported entrepreneurs in exploring, planning, and starting small business enterprises prepared entrepreneurs for operating small business enterprises with training, apprenticeships, mentorships, and similar educational ventures 4.0 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS Please submit responses to the Contracting Officer, Edward Bradford, via email Edward.Bradford@va.gov no later than November 25, 2026. Responses shall not exceed 10 pages total and shall be prepared in Times New Roman, 12-point font, with 1-inch margins. 5.0 LIST OF QUESTIONS Please provide information regarding proposed joint ventures, teaming arrangements, or strategic alliances you believe would be beneficial in supporting the needs of Veterans pursuing self-employment outlined in the background section of this document. Please describe your organization s expertise in providing business planning, self-employment, entrepreneurship, small business operations, and startup incubation services. Please describe how your organization would prepare for and respond to referrals issued by VR&E, specifically the timelines for contacting Veterans participating in the Self-Employment Track and the type of services your organization would provide throughout the engagement. Please describe your organization s service delivery model, including how services would be documented and how progress, milestones, and outcomes would be communicated to VA. On average, how many full-time equivalent (FTE) business consultants, entrepreneurship specialists, or small business advisors are employed by your company? How long has your company been providing self-employment, entrepreneurship development, small business consulting, or related business advisory services? Please provide the qualifications, certifications, or specialized training your business consultants possess related to entrepreneurship? Please describe your experience developing business plans, feasibility studies, and financial projections. title: Application spécialisée «Gestion du marché du travail»
description:
L'objet de l'appel d'offres est l'acquisition d'une application métier destinée à la gestion du marché du travail, ainsi que la fourniture des prestations associées à la conception, à la mise à disposition, à la mise en service, à la migration des données et au déploiement de la solution. Nous recherchons un logiciel standard pouvant être adapté, dans le cadre de sa configuration, aux besoins métier du donneur d’ordre. Le prestataire mettra à disposition l’application métier sous forme de Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) pour une durée fixe de 5 ans et fournira pendant cette période les prestations d’exploitation et d’assistance.


D’un point de vue fonctionnel, l’application métier couvre le traitement des dossiers dans le cadre de la gestion du marché du travail. Elle prend notamment en charge le traitement des tâches relevant des domaines d’exécution « FlaM » et « BGSA », ainsi que d’autres tâches prévues par la loi sur l’assurance-chômage (AIG) et couvre l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’un dossier, de son ouverture à sa clôture en passant par son traitement.

description: ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT SERVICES FOR MAINLAND BRITISH COLUMBIA INFRASTRUCTURE MODERNIZATION PROGRAM (with security requirements) 1. PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at Chilliwack, British Columbia and various range and training areas across Mainland BC. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). 2. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROJECT AND SERVICES It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. APN: 87908 Approximate Estimate: $125,000,000 Anticipated Posting: Winter 2027 Description: The Infrastructure Modernization Program at Chilliwack, British Columbia and various range and training areas across Mainland BC is focused on both recapitalization of existing assets and the development of new infrastructure and facilities where required. As part of this project, the Department of National Defence (DND) wishes to proceed with the renewal of systems which include civil, architectural, mechanical, electrical, and environmental elements to bring the assets to meet current and projected future requirements. This program will include planned phased work packages for implementation over ten (10) years while maintaining operations across Mainland BC. The purpose of this project is to retain the services of a contractor to provide construction management services of pre-construction and construction phases.  Major construction services are expected to include activities such as interior/exterior demolition in the presence of hazardous materials, interior renovations, exterior envelope work, electrical, mechanical, civil, structural and new infrastructure. 3. title: Trenching, Conduit and Ground-well Installation
description: Description The United Stated Embassy in Kingston is requesting proposals for Trenching, Conduit And Ground-Well Installation in various locations on the Embassy compound. The contractor will provide all labor, equipment, supervision, material specific to the back filling and compaction and management needed to complete the job Infrastructure Support System - Handhole / Underground Conduit System Trenching Nine locations have been identified requiring trench work. Thirteen locations have been identified requiring trench work. Before excavation, the Contractor shall locate and verify all existing utilities in the proposed trench alignment. If excavation interferes with existing drains, piping, or structures, the Contractor shall immediately notify, in writing, the COR and provide temporary protection for these systems before proceeding. Trenching from Handholes The Contractor shall make wall penetrations into existing manholes/handholes as required for the number and size of conduits entering and exiting each structure, in accordance with the drawings. Conduit Existing conduit shall remain in place unless the drawings specifically direct removal or modification. Under grass, soil, the Contractor shall install Schedule 80 PVC conduit with a minimum cover of 24 inches (610 mm) from finished grade to top of conduit, or as indicated on the drawings, whichever is greater. All underground 90 degree bends with a 12inch (305 mm) radius shall use prefabricated sweeping bends. Above grade, all underground PVC conduit shall transition to rigid galvanized steel (RGS) using PVC to RGS couplers. The Contractor shall install pull lines in all new conduit runs. Soil and Backfill Materials Soil Materials The Contractor shall provide all labor and materials for soil and backfill, where required. Select Backfill: ASTM D 2487 soil classification groups SW, SP, and SM, or combinations thereof; free of rock or gravel larger than 3 inches (75 mm), debris, waste, frozen materials, vegetation, and other deleterious matter. Asphalt/Concrete Base Course: Naturally or artificially graded mixture of natural or crushed gravel, crushed stone, and natural or crushed sand; ASTM D 2940; with at least 95% passing a 11/2inch (40 mm) sieve and not more than 8% passing a 1/4inch (6.4 mm) sieve. Base Gravel: Naturally or artificially graded mixture of natural or crushed gravel, crushed stone, and natural or crushed sand; ASTM D 2940; 100% passing a 1inch (25 mm) sieve and not more than 8% passing a 1/4inch (6.4 mm) sieve. Sand Cushion: ASTM C 33 fine aggregate, natural or manufactured sand. Placement and Compaction Place backfill and fill in layers not exceeding: 8 inches (203 mm) loose thickness for heavy compaction equipment; 4 inches (102 mm) loose thickness when compacted by hand-operated tampers. Place backfill and fill evenly to the required elevations, uniformly along their full length. Compact soil materials to not less than the following percentages of maximum dry unit weight per ASTM D 1557: Under lawns or unpaved areas: scarify and re-compact top 6 inches (152 mm) below subgrade and compact each layer to 85%. Utility trenches: compact each layer of initial and final backfill to 85%. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Kansas City District is issuing a solicitation for an Integrated Design and Construction (IDaC) services delivery method contract for the construction of a new bed tower, clinical expansion, parking garage in support of the Veterans Affairs St. Louis Health Care System (VASTLHCS) John Cochran (JC) Hospital in St. Louis, Missouri. Offerors shall submit an offer subject to Project Labor Agreement (PLA) requirements in accordance with RFO 22.5, Project Labor Agreements for Federal Construction Projects. Any PLA reached pursuant to the PLA requirements in the solicitation does not change the terms of the contract or provide for any price adjustment by the Government. Funds are fully available for this requirement. The project will be solicited as full and open (unrestricted). The requirements under this construction project include right sizing the VAs medical center by demolishing several deficient and underutilized buildings and then constructing multiple new modern and seismically compliant structures and facilities on the same, expanded site. The newly constructed facilities are incorporated into a master plan for future expansion and demolition of additional primary facilities. The new primary facilities will be acquired using the Integrated Design and Construction (IDaC) delivery method which includes a Pre-Construction Services Phase. The Government will evaluate the performance capability of offerors in accordance with the criteria described in the solicitation resulting in a single award under the best value continuum using the trade-off process in accordance with RFO 15.103-1 to the responsible offeror whose proposal the source selection authority determines conforms to the solicitation, is fair and reasonable, and offers the best overall value to the government, considering non-priced factors described in the solicitation and price. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 236220, (Commercial and Institutional Building Construction), with a small business size standard of $45 million in average annual receipts. The estimated construction magnitude is over $1,000,000,000. The estimated performance period for the pre-construction services phase is 820 calendar days from Notice to Proceed (NTP).Interested offerors must have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM). If the offeror is a Joint Venture (JV), the JV entity must have valid SAM registration in the SAM database representing the JV as one business/firm/entity. A Proposal Guarantee will be required with your proposal in the amount of 20% of the Offerors proposed price or $3,000,000, whichever is less. Payment and Performance Bonds will be required for the full amount (100%) of the awarded contract before the Notice to Proceed can be issued. Point of Contact: The point of contact for all questions/inquiries is Michael France at michael.g.france@usace.army.mil and David Walsh (Contracting Officer) at david.j.walsh@usace.army.mil.

title: Pilot Training Transformation Device Support Services IV (PTT DSS IV)
description: The purpose of this requirement is to maintain and support PTT device solutions based on state- of-the-art commercial simulation environments, hardware solutions for the cockpit simulation environment, and ancillary software elements.The Contractor shall provide all services and equipment necessary to install, maintain, and support new and existing PTT devices. Devices currently fit into the following classifications: common Immersive Training Device (cITD), enhanced Immersive Training Devices (eITD), and Helicopter Immersive Training Device (HITD). Any new classifications will need to be defined and evaluated prior to inclusion in this scope. The Contractor shall support 142 ITDs and up to 17 Instructor Operating Stations (IOS) at the following locations: Joint Base San Antonio (JBSA) Randolph, TX; Columbus Air Force Base (AFB), MS; Laughlin AFB, TX; Vance AFB, OK, Sheppard AFB, TX; and Fort Rucker, AL. The Government has the right to modify the quantity of devices/locations pending contract modification and funding. The Contractor shall maintain a common software interface to integrate current and future PTT software and hardware components as required by program goals, hardware solutions for the cockpit simulation environment, and on-premises network and data architecture hardware and support, as appropriate for deployed training systems.

title: Fællesudbud af trykkeriydelser (2027)
description: Fællesudbud for Københavns Kommune og Frederiksberg Kommune om indgåelse af to rammeaftaler på trykkeriydelser, en rammeaftale for hver kommune. Rammeaftalerne har en løbetid på 4 år og omfatter bestilling, produktion og levering af tryksager, herunder bl.a. plakater, foldere, hæfter, visitkort, bykort og kopi-print. Tilbudsgiver afgiver et samlet tilbud på udbuddets to rammeaftaler, vindende Tilbudsgiver tildeles begge rammeaftaler.Ordregivers krav til kontraktvilkår fremgår af rammeaftale udkastet (bilag A), mens kravene til ydelserne er detaljeret beskrevet i den tekniske specifikation (bilag 1).Københavns Kommune er udførende Ordregiver på udbuddet.

title: Modtagelse og behandling af farligt emballeret affald. Indsamling, håndtering og afsætning af trykflasker.
description: Udbuddet vedrører ydelser i forbindelse med håndtering af farligt affald, herunder modtagelse, håndtering, afsætning, indsamling og transport af farligt affald samt levering af emballage og øvrige materialer til håndteringen. Der er tre delaftaler hvor tilbudsgivere kan byde på én, to eller alle delaftaler. • Delaftale 1: Emballeret farligt affald samt køb og leje af emballage til farligt affald • Delaftale 2: Indsamling, håndtering og afsætning af trykflasker • Delaftale 3 – Indsamling, håndtering og behandling af farlig maling UN1263 og gråzoneaffald Ydelserne leveres til samtlige ordregivers genbrugspladser, samt mindre erhvervsvirksomheder i ordregivers ejerkommuner medmindre andet fremgår af Aftalen. De konkrete ydelser varierer mellem de enkelte delaftaler. For nærmere beskrivelse af de udbudte ydelser, herunder de krav ydelserne skal opfylde, henvises til udbudsmaterialet kravspecifikationen (bilag 2) og tilbudslisten (Bilag 3.1-3), samt eventuelle rettelser og besvarelse af spørgsmål (bilag 1).

title: Germany – Architectural and related services – 2026-01 VGV Architektur Bürgerzentrum
description: Gebäudeplanung nach §§ 33 - 37 HOAI i.V.m. Anlage 10 HOAI, LPH 2 - 9.Die Gemeinde Randersacker beabsichtigt die Neukonzeption des Rathaus-Areals zum „Bürgerzentrum Randersacker“. Ziel ist es, unter Erhalt der denkmalgeschützten Rathausfassade den gestiegenen Raumbedarf der Verwaltung zu decken und zusätzlich Flächen für örtliche Vereine zu schaffen. Für die Umsetzung des erhöhten Flächenbedarfs steht der Bereich des leerstehenden Gebäudeteils "ehemals Beamtenwohnhaus" zur Verfügung. Das Gebäude soll aufgrund des Zustandes, der abweichenden Geschosshöhen, Raumzuschnitten und Brandschutzaspekten abgerissen werden. Die bestehenden Nutzungen (Weltkreisladen mit Touristen-Info, Festausschank, öffentliches WC) sind neu zu integrieren. Das gesamte Areal inklusive Vorplatz und Außenanlagen ist städtebaulich, gestalterisch, energetisch sowie durchgängig barrierefrei aufzuwerten.

title: Luxembourg – Computer-related services – Call for Tenders for the selection of Artificial Intelligence Gigafactory Consortia and the establishment of AI Gigafactories
description: The overall objective of this Call is the selection of Artificial Intelligence Gigafactory (AIGF) Consortia, which will establish and operate the AIGFs and from which the Contracting Parties will acquire AI compute access time. More in detail, the specific objectives of this Call are as follows: - Selection of AIGF Consortia: Following a rigorous evaluation of the tenders by the EuroHPC JU with the support of independent experts, the Governing Board will make an award decision, establishing a ranked list of successful AIGF Consortia. - Procurement of Compute Access Time: To establish a framework for the joint acquisition of a guaranteed share of AI compute access time from the selected AIGF Consortia, formalised through the signature of a Framework Contract and a number of subsequent Specific Contracts with the successful AIGF Consortia. AIGF refers to state-of-the-art large-scale facility with sufficient capacity to handle the complete lifecycle, from development to large-scale inference, of very large AI models and applications, providing a supercomputing service infrastructure which is composed of AI-optimised computing capacity, a supporting data centre infrastructure including high-capacity storage and networking, dedicated secure cloud user access environments, and specialised secure AI-oriented support services for its advanced operations, all of which are supported by an environmentally sustainable infrastructure, in particular for energy and water supply systems.

To do this, SARS needs to outsource some of its data collection activities through procurement, hence spearheading new situational awareness and response capacities in a controlled, manageable and sustainable process.

title: Sweden – Financial analysis software package – ALM System and Services
description: The Swedish National Debt Office (Riksgälden), hereinafter referred to as “SNDO”, requires an Asset and Liability Management (ALM) system and related services, including software licences or subscriptions, implementation, operation, maintenance, support, training and consultancy services, hereinafter collectively referred to as the “ALM System and Services”. The ALM System will be used to perform asset and liability management analyses relating to the system for financing nuclear decommissioning and waste management in Sweden, hereinafter referred to as the “Financing System”. The primary purposes of the analyses are to: a) assess the risk that the assets and future income of the Financing System will be insufficient to meet its future liabilities, including the calculation and analysis of the Risk Margin; and b) support decisions concerning the strategic asset allocation of the Nuclear Waste Fund. The Agreement will enter into force when it has been signed by both parties, which is expected to occur in December 2026. Implementation, model configuration, testing and other activities required for production deployment shall commence following the entry into force of the Agreement. The ALM System shall be approved and ready for production use no later than 1 January 2027. The operational services period will commence on 1 January 2027. The initial operational services period will be three (3) years. Thereafter, the Agreement will be automatically extended for successive periods of one (1) year at a time, unless terminated by SNDO in accordance with the Agreement. The maximum operational services period, including all extensions, is eight (8) years. The procurement is not divided into separate lots. For organisational, functional and risk-related reasons, SNDO requires the ALM System and Services to be provided as a single, integrated delivery. The assignment requires the Supplier to assume overall responsibility for the implementation, functionality, operation, support and maintenance of the ALM System and for the coordination of the related services throughout the contract period. Dividing the procurement into separate lots would make it more difficult to ensure coherent functionality, clear allocation of responsibility and effective implementation and operation. SNDO therefore considers that dividing the procurement into separate lots would not be appropriate.

title: Netherlands – Energy-efficiency consultancy services – Onderzoek/verkenning energiegemeenschappen
description: De gemeenten Bergeijk, Bladel, Eersel, Oirschot en Reusel-De Mierden (hierna: aanbestedende dienst of opdrachtgever) besteden deze opdracht in gezamenlijkheid aan. Bizob treedt op als aanbestedende dienst voor deze aanbesteding namens alle hiervoor genoemde organisaties. De opdracht heeft in eerste instantie betrekking op de uitvoering van de externe verkenning, aangeduid als fase 2. De beoogde ingangsdatum van de overeenkomst is 1 maart 2027. Omdat de opdracht op basis van een hybride specificatie (functionele eisen aangevuld met technische uitvoeringsvoorwaarden) in de markt wordt gezet (zie hoofdstuk 2), kent de overeenkomst geen vaste looptijd. Het betreft een eenmalige, resultaatgerichte dienstverlening die uiterlijk binnen 12 maanden na start wordt afgerond, waarbij geldt dat het eindresultaat formeel door de individuele opdrachtgever dient te zijn geaccepteerd. Beoogd wordt dat het op te leveren eindproduct uiterlijk medio januari 2028 gereed is voor bestuurlijke besluitvorming. Afhankelijk van het resultaat van fase 2 en de besluitvorming hieromtrent door opdrachtgever, kan per individuele gemeente besloten worden tot opdrachtverstrekking voor de optionele vervolgfase (fase 3). Deze fase ziet op de ondersteuning bij de verdere uitwerking en realisatie van initiatieven en energiegemeenschappen. De uitvoering van deze fase is voorzien in de periode vanaf 1 februari 2028 tot en met een nader te bepalen einddatum. De daadwerkelijke doorlooptijd van fase 3 is afhankelijk van verschillende factoren, waaronder de uitkomsten van de externe verkenning, de aard en kenmerken van de initiatieven en de benodigde bestuurlijke besluitvorming. Het tempo en de fasering van de uitvoering kunnen hierdoor per initiatief en gemeente, verschillen.

title: Norway – Research services – Openness and inclusion - police interaction with the entire population
description: The aim of the research assignment is to obtain knowledge about how different groups of the population experience the police, what conditions affect the interaction between police and inhabitants, and how the police can ensure that different perspectives and experiences are heard and safeguarded. There is a need for knowledge about whether there are groups that find that they are not heard, how the police reach out to groups that to a small degree contact the police on their own initiative and how different forms of communication and dialogue are experienced by different groups. The research shall provide a better knowledge basis for how the police can strengthen the dialogue with the population, adapt communication and work forms to different target groups and develop services that safeguard legal security, equal treatment and high quality. The research shall also contribute with knowledge on the connection between transparency, inclusion, trust and the police's legitimacy, as well as the impact this can have on society's resilience. See further information in the tender documentation.

title: Norway – Construction work – Framework agreement bridge maintenance Innlandet and Buskerud 2027-2028
description: The procurement is for a framework agreement for bridge maintenance in the geographical areas Innlandet and Buskerud. The framework agreement includes assignments such as: * Work notification Concrete renovation * Cutting cast land abutment and pillars, retaining wall work, edge binders, concrete sole layer, spray lubrication etc. * Width expansion of bridge plates and land abutments for existing bridges. Alterations to the superstructure. Repairs and replacements of existing railings and assembly of new bridge railings, including railing transitions, branches and end terminations. * Surface treatment of steel and concrete. * Removal of existing and assembly of new drainage pipes. * Repair of joints and joints. * Replacement of asphalt joints and metal joints. * Establishment of simple asphalt and rice-reading joints * Asphalt works * Replacement of membrane and wearing course. The assignments will vary in scope and comprise different maintenance work that is not already included in operational contracts or other maintenance contracts. The work included in the framework agreement is mainly for maintenance work. If there is a need for more comprehensive maintenance work and alteration work on individual bridges, this can be announced as separate contracts. Tenderers must also take an active role in the bridge maintenance and report any damage that is observed on bridges on behalf of the assignment. Such injuries are reported continuously. The amounts stated in chapter 1 are: D1 is based on experiences from previous contracts. The stated amounts are estimated amounts for the expected maintenance need for two years. However, the stated amounts are uncertain. The duration of the framework agreement is from signing of contract until 31.12.2028 The procurement is being announced with an option for a 1+1 year extension. The notice for triggering the first option will be given in writing and at the latest three months before the framework agreement expires. The same notification rules apply for triggering new options. The estimated value of the framework agreement in 2027 is NOK 40- 70 million excluding VAT. The estimated annual value later this year is NOK 40 - 70 million excluding VAT. The maximum value of the framework agreement is NOK 280 million. Excluding VAT.

title: Levee Repairs at Saline County Levee District #2, Ray-Carroll Bottoms Consolidated Levee District of Carroll County, and Howard County Levee District #4
description: PRESOLICITATION NOTICEThe U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Kansas City District, anticipates issuing a solicitation and awarding a single contract for construction services to repair levees at the following locations: Saline County Levee District #2, Ray-Carroll Bottoms Consolidated Levee District of Carroll County, and Howard County Levee District #4. The Government intends to award a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) contract for this project. This will be a 100% Small Business Set-Aside competitive acquisition.The work covered by this contract consist of furnishing all equipment, labor, operators, supervision/site superintendent, quality control, supplies, materials, and incidentals necessary to satisfactorily perform and provide construction to potentially include, but not limited to earthwork operations, bringing in fill and borrow material from a pre-determined site, haul road development, clearing of debris as necessary, erosion repair, rutting repair, levee surfacing, various stone surfacing/placement, installation of stone armored protection, installation and rehabilitation of drainage structures and associated apertures, and establishment of turf for repairs of compromised landside, riverside, and crown levee sections.Currently, a Pre-Solicitation Conference is not scheduled. If the Government decides to hold a conference, this announcement will be amended accordingly.A site visit is planned for this solicitation. Details regarding the date, time, and location will be provided within the solicitation. Any changes to the site visit schedule will be communicated in the solicitation or through subsequent amendments, as applicable.No options are currently identified for this project.In accordance with FAR 36.204 and DFARS 236.204, the estimated magnitude of this construction project is between $250,000 and $500,000.The solicitation will be issued as an Invitation for Bid (IFB), open to all Small Businesses.
